answer_1.quote: We define 5 benchmark tasks over our dataset, i.e., erroneous sentence detection, erroneous span and associated span detection, error type classification, error correction and error rationale generation.
answer_1.outputs: Corrected sentences, error rationales, span annotations, error type labels

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU, Rouge-L and BERT Score . ... We report precision, recall and F0.5 scores using the official Max-Match tool.

answer_4.quote: We also provide human performance on this task. The best model RoBERTa zh is worse than human performance by 26 points.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators judged whether each text is erroneous (binary classification).
